There was no CLI front door for cloning an Entire-native repo — users had to hand-build the `entire://<clusterHost>/et/<project>/<repo>` URL.

## What

Run `entire clone /et/paul/dogbark` (or the `paul/dogbark` shorthand) to resolve the repo's home cluster via the control plane and clone it. `clone` is now also a top-level command — the same command as `repo clone` (the `search` precedent); it still takes `/gh/<owner>/<repo>` refs and raw `entire://` URLs.
